SYED EQBAL ALAM (Member, IEEE) received the Master of Technology degree from the
International Institute of Information Technology
Bangalore (IIIT B), India, and the Ph.D. degree
from the Concordia Institute for Information Systems Engineering (CIISE), Concordia University, Montreal, QC, Canada. He is currently a
Postdoctoral Fellow with the J. Herbert Smith Center for Technology Management & Entrepreneurship, Faculty of Engineering, University of New
Brunswick, Fredericton, NB, Canada. Before the Ph.D. degree, he was
a Lecturer with Taif University, Saudi Arabia. He taught undergraduate
computer science courses, such as object-oriented programming, data structure and algorithms, distributed systems, artificial intelligence, and discrete
mathematics. His research interest includes performing research that leads to
excellent theories and exciting applications. He broadly works on distributed
optimization, federated optimization, differential privacy, the Internet of
Things, federated learning, and algebraic structures. He has been a reviewer
of several conferences and journals, including IEEE Conference on Decision and Control, European Conference on Artificial Intelligence, IEEE
TRANSACTIONS ON AUTOMATIC CONTROL, and IEEE ACCESS.

DHIRENDRA SHUKLA received the M.B.A.
degree from the Telfer School of Management,
University of Ottawa, Canada, and the dual
Ph.D. degree in entrepreneurial finance from the
University of London, U.K., and University of
London.
He is currently a Professor and the Dr. J. Herbert
Smith ACOA Chair of Technology Management
and Entrepreneurship with the University of New
Brunswick, Fredericton. He utilizes his expertise
from the telecommunication sector and extensive academic background in
the areas of entrepreneurial finance, business administration, and engineering
to promote a bright future in NB, Canada. His passionate about entrepreneurship, design, engineering, innovation, and leadership. He ignites this same
passion in others through his teaching with UNB, local entrepreneurial
community outreach, and the creation of programs, such as the Master
of Technology Management and Entrepreneurship, Technology Commercialization Program, and Summer Institute. He recognition of his tireless
efforts and vision is demonstrated through UNB 2014 Award from Startup
Canada as Most Entrepreneurial Post Secondary Institution of the Year, his
nomination as a Finalist of Industry Champion by KIRA, and most recently,
his nomination as a Finalist of Progress Medias Innovation in Practice Award.

SHRISHA RAO (Senior Member, IEEE) received
the M.S. degree in logic and computation from
Carnegie Mellon University and the Ph.D. degree
in computer science from the University of
Iowa.
He is currently a Professor with the Graduate School of Information Technology,
IIIT Bangalore, Bengaluru, India. His research
interests include the applications of agent-based
modeling and artificial intelligence to understand
human cognition and emergent social phenomena, sustainability, bioinformatics, and intelligent transportation systems.
Dr. Rao was an ACM Distinguished Speaker, from 2015 to 2021. He is
also a Life Member of the American Mathematical Society and the Computer
Society of India. He is on the editorial boards of Sādhanā, The Knowledge
Engineering Review, and PLOS One. He has had editing assignments of
the IEEE SYSTEMS JOURNAL and Frontiers in Public Health. He has been a
reviewer of many journals of several major publishers and has served as a
program committee member for several international conferences.
